title: Maths reference: Year 8 Space
summary: The words and methods from Year 8 Space, each with an example and, where it helps, a picture of the board.
_about: Maths cards for maths/space-8 (see snippets/maths-algebra-7.json for the format; split from the strand courses' card files on 1 Nov 2026).

items.label: congruence tests
items.hint: Each set of equal parts fixes a triangle. In SAS the angle is between the two sides; SSA is not a test, because it can give two triangles.
items.board:
widget: congruence
test: SSA
p: 8
q: 6
s: 40
items.shows: Two different triangles with the same SSA parts

items.label: scale factor
items.hint: Similar shapes: every length times k, every angle the same. Triangles are similar by AA, SSS (sides in one ratio) or SAS.
items.board:
widget: similar
shape: triangle
sides: 3, 4, 5
k: 2
items.shows: A 3, 4, 5 triangle and a copy twice as big

items.label: diagonals of quadrilaterals
items.hint: A parallelogram's diagonals cut each other in half; a kite's cross at 90°. Prove a property with two congruent triangles.
items.board:
widget: geometry
shape: polygon
sides: 4
corners: 3,1; 9,1; 9,5; 3,5
classify: on
diagonals: on
sum: off
items.shows: A rectangle with its two equal diagonals

items.label: parallelogram angles
items.hint: Neighbouring angles are co-interior between parallel sides. All four add to 360°.

items.label: 3D coordinates
items.hint: Along x, along y, then up z. The order is always x, y, z; points on the floor have z = 0.

items.label: congruence algorithm
items.hint: Ask the congruence tests first, then the similarity conditions, and end with a catch-all. Test on one pair of each kind, including SSA.
